_meta.purpose: Settings of plain-text-review.json's in-scope groups (sentences, interface strings, clickable labels, form controls) that cannot hold markup at all, each with the cited proof, plus the per-setting facts the check reads (noLink, linksAllowed, printPaths, controlFiles). Read by scripts/check-authored-text-rich.py.
_meta.linksAllowed: '<block>:<attr>' of the 'form controls' group whose text prints outside a label, button or link, so a link format may stay. Every other form-control and clickable-label setting takes the no-link list.
_meta.noLink: '<block>:<attr>' of an interface string or sentence that prints inside a link, button or summary although its group does not say so: it takes the no-link list and prints with sgs_rich_text_kses( $v, false ).
_meta.printPaths: '<block>:<attr>' -> PHP files (relative to the plugin) where the setting is printed when that is not the reader file or a file of the block: they must hold a sanitised print call.
_meta.controlFiles: '<block>:<attr>' -> files outside the block folder that mount its rich control (a shared atom, its attribute named through a key lookup).
_meta.unconvertible: '<block>:<attr>' -> why the setting cannot hold markup at all. A reason starts `cannot hold markup:` and cites the code (a src/ or includes/ path) that proves the value is only ever an attribute, a slug or structured data, never page text. Anything else left plain fails the check; there are no pending entries.

unconvertible.sgs/buybox:soldOutLabel: cannot hold markup: the value is only ever an attribute. render.php passes it in the block context (`soldOutLabel`) and src/blocks/product-card/view.js::updateAvailability writes it with `input.setAttribute( 'aria-label', term.label + ' ' + ctx.soldOutLabel )`; no element prints it as page text.
unconvertible.sgs/buybox:unavailableLabel: cannot hold markup: only ever an attribute. render.php passes it in the block context (`unavailableLabel`) and src/blocks/product-card/view.js writes it with `input.setAttribute( 'aria-label', term.label + ' ' + ctx.unavailableLabel )`; no element prints it as page text.
unconvertible.sgs/choice-flow:title: cannot hold markup: only ever an attribute. src/blocks/choice-flow/render.php reads it as `$flow_title` and writes it as `$wrapper_args['aria-label']`; no element prints it as page text.
unconvertible.sgs/google-reviews:businessName: cannot hold markup: it only feeds the structured data. includes/helpers-reviews-inline.php::sgs_reviews_inline_data stores it as `displayName.text` and src/blocks/google-reviews/render.php writes it as the JSON-LD `name` (`'name' => $business_name`); no element prints it, and JSON-LD names are plain strings.
unconvertible.sgs/icon:brandName: cannot hold markup: it is a registry slug, not words. src/blocks/icon/render.php reads it as `$brand_name = preg_replace( '/[^a-z0-9-]/', '', strtolower( ... ) )` and looks the glyph up with sgs_brand_by_slug( $brand_name ); any markup would be stripped to its letters.
unconvertible.sgs/form-field-consent:label: cannot hold markup: src/blocks/form-field-consent/render.php never prints `label` (the visible words are `consentText`, already rich); `label` only feeds includes/forms/field-render-helpers.php::field_submission_name (a slug) and field_open's no-label class, and the block has no inspector control for it.
